name: aiseo-monthly-keyword-research
prompt: Run keyword-opportunity for the top keyword from MEMORY.md '## 关注关键词' section (seed_keyword = first entry). Use market and language from MEMORY.md '## 目标市场 / 受众' (default US/en if absent). Produce the 3-section opportunity report. If MEMORY.md has no tracked keyword, ask the user and skip this run.

_aiseo_notes.purpose: monthly keyword opportunity scan — find new long-tail / intent gaps relative to tracked seed keyword
_aiseo_notes.tool_budget: <= 8 web_search calls + <= 1 web_extract for top-3 page verification
_aiseo_notes.deliver_choice_rationale: same as weekly-audit — local sink, no messaging
